preconditions.description: The number of users n must be between 2 and 250,000.
Both T_1 and T_2 must have exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges_T1) and all(1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n for c, d in edges_T2)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in edges of T_1 and T_2 must be within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The number of protected edges m must be between 0 and n-1.
The number of output edges must equal the number of protected edges m.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) in edges_T1 and (c, d) in edges_T2 for a, b, c, d in output_edges)
postconditions.description: All output edges must belong to their respective networks T_1 and T_2.

postconditions.expression: all((a, b) != (c, d) for a, b, c, d in output_edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge in T_1 must be replaced by a distinct edge in T_2.
